modules.title: Execute a Contract Method
modules.description: This action will execute one of the Contract Methods you have defined in your 1Shot API account and create a Transaction.

fields.Label: Choose the Contract Method you want to execute
Enter the parameters for the Contract Method
fields.Helper text: This must be in JSON format. For example, a "mint" method's params may look like this: {"amount":"10000","to":"0x3e6a2f0CBA03d293B54c9fCF354948903007a798"}. This must be at least an object, {}

fields.Label: Enter any text you want included with the Transaction as a memo
fields.Helper text: This may be anything you want, including technical information you want to save. Many people use JSON here.

fields.Label: What is the maximum amount of gas to use?
fields.Helper text: 1Shot API calculates this for you in most circumstances, but some complex transactions may need more gas.

fields.Label: How much native token should be sent with the Transaction?
fields.Helper text: Enter a value only for "payable" contract methods that need to send native token to the smart contract.

fields.Helper text: Optional

fields.Label: Do you want transactions from only a single chain?
fields.Helper text: Optional

fields.Label: Do you want transactions that contain a particular memo?
fields.Helper text: Will return partial matches- IE "illicit" will match transactions with memo "illicit activity". This is case-insensitive as well.

fields.Label: Do you want to limit it to transactions created after a certain point in time?
fields.Helper text: Optional

fields.Label: Do you want to limit it to transactions created before a certain point in time?
fields.Helper text: Optional

fields.Helper text: The headline on the tile, up to 120 characters. For example: Backup running.

fields.Label: What is the current state?
fields.Helper text: A short state word shown on the tile, up to 40 characters. For example: Printing, Building, Out for delivery.

fields.Label: How far along is it, as a percentage?
fields.Helper text: A number from 0 to 100, which draws a progress bar on the tile. Leave blank for no bar.

fields.Label: What line of detail goes under it?
fields.Helper text: A line of detail under the title, up to 300 characters.

fields.Label: Which symbol should it show?
fields.Helper text: An SF Symbol name shown on the tile, for example printer.fill or shippingbox.fill.

fields.Label: How many seconds until it finishes?
fields.Helper text: Draws a live countdown that ticks on its own. SECONDS, not milliseconds: 45 minutes is 2700. Maximum 86400.

fields.Label: What accent color should it use?
fields.Helper text: A hex color for the tile accent, for example #FF9500.

fields.Label: What goes at the trailing edge?
fields.Helper text: A short value shown at the trailing edge, up to 40 characters. For example a percentage or a count.

fields.Label: How many stages are there in total?
fields.Helper text: Turns the progress bar into stage segments. A number from 2 to 20, for example 5 for a five stage deploy. Use it with Completed stages.

fields.Label: How many stages are done?
fields.Helper text: How many stages are finished, from 0 up to the total. 3 of 5 lights the first three segments.

fields.Label: What should the button say?
fields.Helper text: Puts a tappable button on the tile, up to 20 characters, for example Pause or Dashboard. It needs a button address too.

fields.Label: What should the button call?
fields.Helper text: An https address. The phone calls it when the button is tapped, and Notify servers are not involved, so a webhook on your own network works. It needs a button label too.

fields.Label: Should the button open the link?
fields.Helper text: Yes opens the address like a link. No, the default, fires it quietly in the background as a webhook.

fields.Label: Which values should it show side by side?
fields.Helper text: Shows values side by side like a small dashboard. One per line as Label: Value, up to six lines. For example CPU: 87% on one line and Memory: 62% on the next.

fields.Label: Which live activity?
fields.Helper text: The Activity ID from the Start a live activity step, which looks like LA7K2P9Q. Leave it blank to change whichever tile this device is showing, which is what a one trigger, one action Applet needs.

fields.Label: How long should the finished tile stay?
fields.Helper text: Seconds to leave the final state on the Lock Screen before it disappears, up to 14400. Leave it blank for the usual behavior.

modules.title: Start a live activity
modules.description: This action will start a Live Activity, a live tile on your iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island that updates in place while something is running.

fields.Label: What should the tile say?
fields.Helper text: The headline on the tile, up to 120 characters. For example: Backup running.

fields.Label: What is the current state?
fields.Helper text: A short state word shown on the tile, up to 40 characters. For example: Printing, Building, Out for delivery.

fields.Label: How far along is it, as a percentage?
fields.Helper text: A number from 0 to 100, which draws a progress bar on the tile. Leave blank for no bar.

fields.Label: What line of detail goes under it?
fields.Helper text: A line of detail under the title, up to 300 characters.

fields.Label: Which symbol should it show?
fields.Helper text: An SF Symbol name shown on the tile, for example printer.fill or shippingbox.fill.

fields.Label: How many seconds until it finishes?
fields.Helper text: Draws a live countdown that ticks on its own. SECONDS, not milliseconds: 45 minutes is 2700. Maximum 86400.

fields.Label: What accent color should it use?
fields.Helper text: A hex color for the tile accent, for example #FF9500.

fields.Label: What goes at the trailing edge?
fields.Helper text: A short value shown at the trailing edge, up to 40 characters. For example a percentage or a count.

fields.Label: How many stages are there in total?
fields.Helper text: Turns the progress bar into stage segments. A number from 2 to 20, for example 5 for a five stage deploy. Use it with Completed stages.

fields.Label: How many stages are done?
fields.Helper text: How many stages are finished, from 0 up to the total. 3 of 5 lights the first three segments.

fields.Label: What should the button say?
fields.Helper text: Puts a tappable button on the tile, up to 20 characters, for example Pause or Dashboard. It needs a button address too.

fields.Label: What should the button call?
fields.Helper text: An https address. The phone calls it when the button is tapped, and Notify servers are not involved, so a webhook on your own network works. It needs a button label too.

fields.Label: Should the button open the link?
fields.Helper text: Yes opens the address like a link. No, the default, fires it quietly in the background as a webhook.

fields.Label: Which values should it show side by side?
fields.Helper text: Shows values side by side like a small dashboard. One per line as Label: Value, up to six lines. For example CPU: 87% on one line and Memory: 62% on the next.
